claim: Overlapping Build sectors glitch when the overlap's footprint is reachable down both branches, or when the parents' walls mutually straddle (wallfront -2) while both are drawn. Floors carry no depth of their own; they inherit the order of the walls they hang on.
evidence: Calibrated on the owner's hand-built maps in tests/data/sector_overlap (bad_1..9, good_1, 2, 5), 2026-08-29.
use: Check overlaps with the vector report; its test runs in under a second.
